subject: OrbitX production rollout — Sales→CS transition & acceptance gates
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitx.com>
Cc: OrbitX Procurement <procurement@orbitx.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OrbitX production rollout — Sales→CS transition & acceptance gates

Hi team,

Quick handoff note on OrbitX (deal RDW-8421). We closed last week — signed PO arrived and legal countersigned the SOW attached. Primary goal: get them to a guarded production rollout (limited traffic / beta) by 2026-12-15 with full rollout by 2027-01-15. Key items to carry forward:

- Scope: Redwood API (hosted) with dedicated routing for core search and embeddings. Expected avg qps ~25, spiky to 80 during batch windows.
- SLAs: customer will require 99.9% availability for the dedicated routes; they requested a latency target of ~120ms p50 for 2k token responses.
- Security: OrbitX requires SOC2 evidence and customer-managed KMS for private keys. Procurement has the KMS details in the cc.
- Billing & procurement: PO #8342 — procurement contact is on cc and expects invoice by 11/30.

Attachments: OrbitX_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), deployment-checklist.xlsx (xlsx). I also dropped a minimal credential stub (orbitx-credentials-stub.txt) with the placeholder names for required service accounts.

Asks for CS: please confirm the primary CS steward and the initial acceptance gates you want us to commit to (we recommended a 2-week pilot with a limited subset of production traffic). Also flag any infra pre-reqs that could delay the 12/15 target.

Liam — looping you so the CS team has a direct contact for schedule/acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment stubs:
- OrbitX_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)
- deployment-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitx.com>, OrbitX Procurement <procurement@orbitx.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrbitX production rollout — Sales→CS transition & acceptance gates

Thanks Rachel — good summary.

We'll take custody of the onboarding. I will be the intake owner for the sprint-zero plan and will nominate a primary CS steward by EOD tomorrow. Initial thoughts / immediate risks:

- IAM/KMS: customer-managed KMS integration usually takes 2–3 weeks to validate with our infra team (depends on key escrow flow).
- Traffic profile: the spike to 80 qps will require reserved capacity or autoscale policy tweaks on Dedicated; please share historical qps sample if available.
- SLOs: 120ms p50 for 2k tokens is aggressive on hosted tiers; we'll test against a staging endpoint.

Action items (Ben):
1) Review attached SOW + deployment checklist and mark any redlines for legal by 11/25.
2) Provision a staging route and run a 48hr soak test with representative payloads (ETA 12/03).
3) Nominate CS steward (primary) and onboarding lead (ops) — will confirm 11/22 morning.

Onboard plan will include: kickoff meeting (1hr), security evidence handoff (SOC2 artifacts + KMS proof), staging soak, pilot acceptance run, then go/no-go signoff.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitx.com>
Cc: OrbitX Procurement <procurement@orbitx.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OrbitX production rollout — Sales→CS transition & acceptance gates

Thanks for the handoff — and congrats on the close. I'll own the customer success stewardship for the onboarding and will coordinate the implementation lead (ops) with Ben. Confirming high-level timeline and acceptance gates below.

Proposed sprint-zero (high level):
- 11/23: Handoff kickoff (30–45m) — attendees: Rachel, Ben, Marissa, OrbitX engineering + procurement rep.
- 11/24–12/02: Security evidence exchange + KMS integration validation (parallel).
- 12/03–12/10: Staging soak / performance baseline (48hr soak inside dates).
- 12/11–12/14: Pilot with limited production traffic (feature flags, throttles).
- 12/15: Pilot go/no-go; if green, widen rollout window to phased release through 01/15.

Acceptance gates (what CS needs to sign off):
1) Staging pass: no regressions >1% error rate and p95 latency within 2x target for representative payloads.
2) Security: SOC2 artifact set uploaded + KMS key rotation documented and validated.
3) Capacity: dedicated route provisioned or autoscale policy confirmed to handle 80 qps spike in pilot window.
4) Commercial: invoice processed and PO confirmed (procurement cc'd).

Attachments included (first pass):
- deployment-checklist.xlsx — I've added an 'owner' column and flagged two infra blockers (IAM mapping + NLB healthcheck config).
- OrbitX_SOW_v1.pdf — reviewed; only small clarifications around SLA definitions (will send redline suggestions by 11/25).

Request: Liam, can your engineering lead share a sample of typical request size (token counts) and one anonymized sample payload for performance testing? If procurement can confirm invoice timeline that helps avoid scheduling drift.

I'll set up the kickoff for 11/23 at 11:00am PT and share a calendar invite shortly.

Best,
Marissa Cole | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 617-555-0104

Attachment stubs:

- OrbitX_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)

Perfect — thanks Marissa (and Ben). A couple quick internal notes:

- Procurement asked us to confirm that invoice will be sent to accounts-payable@orbitx.com (procurement cc). Rachel (sales) will confirm once legal approves the minor SOW clarifications.
- Risk to schedule: if KMS validation slips beyond 12/01 we need to move the staging window; please flag immediately.

Ben — please add the staging endpoint details to the runbook link and share the HubSpot deal note with the 'steward assigned' tag once you confirm the ops lead.

I'll be available on the kickoff; happy to jump into any executive escalations if procurement or legal needs faster cycles.

Thanks,
Rachel
